annotation.title_clean: 民政部关于印发《城乡三级养老服务网络建设管理指引》的通知
annotation.title_en: Ministry of Civil Affairs Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction and Management of the Urban-Rural Three-Tier Elderly Care Service Network
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 民政部 (Ministry of Civil Affairs of China)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Civil Affairs of China
annotation.summary_en: Ministry of Civil Affairs notice (May 2026) issuing guidelines for a county, township and village/community three-tier elderly care service network in China, defining each tier's setup, functions and operating mechanisms, accreditation, and monitoring. It contains no robotics or AI governance, only passing mention of smart technology.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes county-level comprehensive elderly care management platforms, township/street regional centers, and village/community stations
Prefecture-level civil affairs departments accredit county platforms and township centers and mark them on the national platform
Priority on care for disabled and dementia elderly and caregiver training
Provincial authorities must integrate targets into the 15th Five-Year Plan and monitor utilization and satisfaction
Encourages smart management, e-records for elderly, and social-capital participation
